name: @dsh-toolset/term-check
description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）term-check 插件：检查回复正文是否用了「禁止术语」表里的旧称，命中时经 rule-engine 注入一条更正提示（只报不改）

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-term-check && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-term-check && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-term-check node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-term-check tmp/cov-term-check/report.json
